step1_analysis.circuit_type: Passive Loop Filter for Phase-Locked Loop (PLL)
step1_analysis.description: A 3rd-order passive low-pass filter used in a charge-pump PLL to convert charge pump current pulses into a smooth DC control voltage for the VCO. It features an integrating capacitor (C1) with a zero-setting resistor (R1), and additional high-frequency poles (C2, R3, C3) to suppress reference spurs.

paper_reference.title: A 2.4-GHz Monolithic Fractional-N Frequency Synthesizer With Robust Phase-Switching Prescaler and Loop Capacitance Multiplier

Transimpedance_10kHz.description: Low-frequency transimpedance magnitude, dominated by the integrating capacitor.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical 1nF effective integrating capacitance for a 250kHz loop bandwidth.

Transimpedance_250kHz.description: Transimpedance magnitude at the expected loop bandwidth (250 kHz).

sky130_expected.calculation: At 250kHz, Z is dominated by R1 (6.3k) and attenuated slightly by the poles. Z ~ 6kOhm -> 75 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sets the open-loop gain crossover frequency in conjunction with charge pump current and VCO Kvco.

Phase_250kHz.description: Phase shift of the filter at the loop bandwidth, critical for PLL phase margin.

sky130_expected.calculation: Integrator (-90) + Zero at 25kHz (+84) - Poles at 1MHz (-28) = -34 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: A phase shift of -34 degrees from the filter leaves 180 - 90(VCO) - 34 = 56 degrees of phase margin, which is optimal for loop stability.

Transient_Ripple.description: Peak-to-peak voltage ripple on the VCO control line due to charge pump pulses.

sky130_expected.calculation: For a 100uA pulse of 0.5us duration into C2=25pF and C3=25pF, ripple is smoothed by the R3-C3 filter.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ripple must be minimized to reduce fractional and reference spurs in the synthesizer output.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the AC transimpedance, phase response, and transient ripple of the PLL loop filter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* PLL Loop Filter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Component values for ~250kHz loop bandwidth
.param R1_val=6.3k C1_val=1n C2_val=25p R3_val=6.3k C3_val=25p

* DUT: Loop Filter
R1 IIN N1 {R1_val}
C1 N1 GND {C1_val}
C2 IIN GND {C2_val}
R3 IIN VOUT {R3_val}
C3 VOUT GND {C3_val}

* Ground definition
Vgnd GND 0 DC 0

* DC path to ground to prevent floating nodes during OP/AC
R_dc IIN 0 1T

* Input source: AC current for transimpedance, Pulse for transient
* Simulating a 100uA charge pump pulse
I_in 0 IIN DC 0 AC 1 PULSE(0 100u 1u 1n 1n 0.5u 2u)

.control
* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 10Meg
let z_mag_db = vdb(VOUT)
let z_phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT))

meas ac z_mag_10k find z_mag_db at=10k
meas ac z_mag_250k find z_mag_db at=250k
meas ac phase_250k find z_phase at=250k

* Transient Analysis
tran 10n 5u
meas tran vout_max max v(VOUT)
meas tran vout_min min v(VOUT)
let vout_ripple = vout_max - vout_min
print vout_ripple

quit
.endc
